Naming and Writing.when_pressured: You may keep explaining long after the signal has already become clear.
Naming and Writing.evidence_sentence: Mercury, air, third-house, or sixth-house signatures may strengthen this restoration key.

Ritual and Repetition.consumer_description: Coherence returns through repeated symbolic structure, trustworthy cadence, and small acts that tell the system where it is in time.
Ritual and Repetition.mechanism: At its clearest, Ritual and Repetition holds the threshold so the psyche does not have to improvise every return.
Ritual and Repetition.restoration: Let ritual hold the threshold without hardening into compulsion.
Ritual and Repetition.experiment: Repeat one small closing ritual at the end of each work session.
Ritual and Repetition.when_supported: The repeated practice is simple enough to sustain and meaningful enough to matter.
Ritual and Repetition.when_pressured: The form can become more important than the coherence it was meant to restore.
Ritual and Repetition.evidence_sentence: Saturn, earth, fixed, sixth-house, or tenth-house signatures may strengthen this restoration key.

Trusted Witnessing.consumer_description: Coherence returns through safe reflection with someone who can stay clear, kind, and present.
Trusted Witnessing.mechanism: In coherence, Trusted Witnessing lets the system stop holding everything alone without giving the process away.
Trusted Witnessing.restoration: Choose witnesses who can receive the truth without making your process about their comfort.
Trusted Witnessing.experiment: Ask one trusted person to reflect what they hear rather than solve it.
Trusted Witnessing.when_supported: The witness can listen without taking over, rescuing, judging, or demanding performance.
Trusted Witnessing.when_pressured: The need to be witnessed can become dependence on the wrong audience.
Trusted Witnessing.evidence_sentence: Moon, Venus, Mercury, air, water, or seventh-house signatures may strengthen this restoration key.

Material Simplification.consumer_description: Coherence returns through cleaning, budgeting, reducing friction, and making the real world easier to inhabit.
Material Simplification.mechanism: When coherent, Material Simplification restores the nervous system by reducing avoidable drag.
Material Simplification.restoration: Simplify the material field without trying to perfect it.
Material Simplification.experiment: Remove one recurring friction from your space, calendar, or money flow.
Material Simplification.when_supported: The practical field becomes easier without turning into a perfection project.
Material Simplification.when_pressured: Simplification can become control when every loose edge feels intolerable.
Material Simplification.evidence_sentence: Saturn, Mercury, earth, second-house, or sixth-house signatures may strengthen this restoration key.

Clean Agreement.consumer_description: Coherence returns through renegotiation, boundary, and explicit commitment.
Clean Agreement.mechanism: At its best, Clean Agreement turns relational static into terms the system can trust.
Clean Agreement.restoration: Say what is available now and what needs a new agreement.
Clean Agreement.experiment: Rewrite one vague relational expectation as a clear request, limit, or commitment.
Clean Agreement.when_supported: Expectations are named before resentment has to become the boundary.
Clean Agreement.when_pressured: Unspoken obligations may keep collecting interest until the relationship feels expensive.
Clean Agreement.evidence_sentence: Saturn, Venus, Mercury, air, earth, seventh-house, or tenth-house signatures may strengthen this restoration key.
